description: This file defines the ReviewerUserRole class which extends AbstractUserRole and manages access permissions for reviewers in the HRM system, specifically related to employees, performance trackers, and logs. It uses traits for authentication and service access, indicating it handles role-based authorization logic.

classes.name: ReviewerUserRole
classes.description: A class responsible for handling reviewer role permissions within the HRM system. It provides methods to retrieve accessible employee, tracker, and log IDs based on reviewer permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleIdsForEntity
methods.description: Returns accessible entity IDs based on entity type for the reviewer, such as employees, tracker IDs, or log IDs.

methods.name: getAccessibleEmployeeIdsForReviewer
methods.description: Retrieves employee IDs associated with the reviewer if specific permission is granted.

methods.name: getAccessibleTrackerIdsForReviewer
methods.description: Retrieves performance tracker IDs associated with the reviewer.

methods.name: getAccessibleTrackerLogIdsForReviewer
methods.description: Retrieves performance tracker log IDs associated with the user.
